gloss: visible; visual; within the range of sight

definitions.gloss: visible; visual; able to be seen
definitions.explanation: Describes something that can be seen with the eyes. Most commonly used as a prefix in compound words related to visibility and optics.

examples.english: Visible light is light that can be seen by the human eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可視|かし}{化|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。

{可視|かし}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しか⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Stars outside the visible range can only be seen with a telescope.

notes:
Primarily used as a prefix in compound words rather than as a standalone adjective. Appears frequently in scientific, technical, and business contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {可視|かし}{光|こう}/{可視|かし}{光線|こうせん}: visible light
- {可視|かし}{化|か}: visualization (making data or processes visible)
- {可視|かし}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: visible range
- {可視|かし}⟦{領域|りょういき}→領域：05459_ryouiki⟧: visible spectrum/domain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不可視|ふかし}: invisible, non-visible
- ⟦{赤外線|せきがいせん}→赤外線：15005_sekigaisen⟧: infrared (below visible light)
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧: ultraviolet (above visible light)

FORMS:
{可|か} (possible) + {視|し} (to see) — literally "can be seen"
